description: This file defines the Android activity 'ContentInfoActivity' that displays detailed information about a TV content. It handles UI rendering, focus management for TV remote navigation, and user interactions including button focus animations and actions. The activity loads content data from intent extras or defaults, updates date/time displays, and manages six focusable action buttons with custom key handling for D-Pad navigation.

classes.name: ContentInfoActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that displays detailed content information for TV content, including focus management and user interaction handling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and populates content data.

methods.name: setupSystemDateTime
methods.description: Sets the current system date and time in the UI.

methods.name: populateContentData
methods.description: Retrieves content information from intent extras or defaults and populates UI elements.

methods.name: setupActionButtons
methods.description: Initializes action buttons, sets icons/labels, focus behavior, key handling, and click actions.

methods.name: animateButtonFocus
methods.description: Animates visual focus state transitions for action buttons.

methods.name: onKeyDown
methods.description: Handles back press to finish activity.

methods.name: handleButtonAction
methods.description: Provides visual and logical handling when an action button is pressed.

methods.name: createIntent
methods.description: Factory method to create intents to launch this activity with specific content data.
